hr.tips: Use a 60–90 second pitch: present role, relevant background, and why you're a fit.
hr.ideal_answer: A concise 60–90 second pitch: who you are today, 2–3 relevant experiences or skills, and why this role and company fit your goals.

hr.text: What are your greatest strengths and weaknesses?
hr.tips: Pick one real weakness and explain how you're improving it.

hr.text: Why do you want to work at this company?
hr.tips: Research the company mission, product, and culture — be specific.

hr.text: Where do you see yourself in five years?
hr.tips: Show ambition aligned with growth at the company, not unrelated dreams.
Summarize 2–3 skills + one concrete achievement that matches the role.
Give a researched range; show flexibility and focus on the role first.

technical.text: Explain the difference between a stack and a queue. When would you use each?
technical.tips: Mention LIFO vs FIFO and give one real use case for each.
technical.ideal_answer: A stack is LIFO (last-in-first-out) — used for undo, recursion, DFS. A queue is FIFO (first-in-first-out) — used for BFS, task scheduling, print queues.

technical.text: What is overfitting in machine learning, and how do you prevent it?
technical.tips: Cover train/validation split, regularization, and cross-validation.

technical.text: Describe how a REST API works. What makes an API RESTful?
technical.tips: Mention HTTP methods, statelessness, and resource URLs.

technical.text: What is the time complexity of binary search? Walk through how it works.
technical.tips: State O(log n) and explain halving the search space each step.

technical.text: Explain what embeddings are and why they are used in modern AI applications.
technical.tips: Connect text → vectors → semantic similarity; mention RAG as an example.

technical.text: What is the difference between SQL and NoSQL databases? When would you choose each?
technical.tips: Contrast schema, scaling, and consistency; give one use case per type.

technical.text: How does React's virtual DOM improve performance?
technical.tips: Explain diffing, batching updates, and minimizing direct DOM manipulation.

behavioral.text: Tell me about a time you worked on a team project. What was your role?
behavioral.tips: Use STAR: Situation, Task, Action, Result — focus on collaboration.
behavioral.ideal_answer: Use STAR: describe the Situation, your Task, the Actions you took with the team, and the measurable Result (grades, delivery, feedback).

behavioral.text: Describe a situation where you showed leadership, even without a formal title.
behavioral.tips: Highlight initiative, influence, and a measurable outcome.

behavioral.text: Tell me about a conflict with a teammate. How did you resolve it?
behavioral.tips: Stay professional; emphasize listening, empathy, and a constructive resolution.

behavioral.text: Describe a time you failed at something. What did you learn?
behavioral.tips: Own the failure honestly; end with a clear lesson and what you changed.

behavioral.text: Tell me about a time you had to meet a tight deadline. How did you prioritize?
behavioral.tips: Explain prioritization, communication with stakeholders, and the outcome.

behavioral.text: Give an example of when you received critical feedback. How did you respond?
behavioral.tips: Show openness, reflection, and concrete steps you took to improve.
